title: v2 hard-filter rules on the survivorship-free Indian panel (pre-registered, FY2016/FY2018): promoter pledge >25% and >50% clear the graded-red bar; CFO/PAT, debt+negative CFO, other income, debtor days stay questions; nothing hard
body: Redo of hard_filters_test Part B without survivorship bias, on the solvency_india panel (489 company-snapshots, 301 companies, D distress census + X delisted sample + L live sample, weighted; non-financial, Rs 200-20,000 cr at T; 5y O_fail = liquidation or compulsory exit or price <=0.2x, weighted base 19.7%). Pledge at T from BSE SHP XBRL filed before T (419 rows known). Lift [stratified company bootstrap], share of >=3x winners flagged: pledge>25% 2.13 [1.53,2.94], 8.5% -> GRADED RED; pledge>50% 2.43 [1.65,3.47], 5.9% -> GRADED RED (FY2016 2.47, FY2018 2.44; O_strict 5.19); CFO/PAT 5y<0.3 2.08 [0.57,3.85], 11.3% -> question; debt>=1.5x in 3y with 3y CFO<0 0.83 -> question/no signal; other income>50% of PBT 1.36 [0.85,1.92] -> question; debtor days x1.5 in 3y 1.51 [0.83,2.37], 19% -> question; ANY 1.31, flags 47% of winners -> question. Logged deviation before outcomes: history-dependent rules (a,c,e, ANY) are FY2018-only because live firms' screener pages start at FY2015 (FY2016 coverage would be fate-dependent). Versus old survivors-only Part B (2020): pledged firms tripled MORE there (69% vs 51%); here they tripled half as often (15% vs 28%) and lost >50% three times as often (31% vs 11%). Post-hoc: 60% of pledge flags overlap interest cover <1.5x; lift among adequately-covered firms ~1.5-1.75 (CI includes 1). Implausible-economics proxy not tested (L20). Research, not SEBI-registered advice.

title: Promoter pledge at T is the strongest mechanical stage-2 rule in India: >50% of promoter holding doubles-plus 5-year failure odds (lift 2.43) and flags 6% of later multibaggers; not hard
body: Survivorship-free Indian panel, FY2016/FY2018 snapshots, pledge from the latest BSE SHP XBRL filed before T. >25%: 98 of 419 rows fired, precision 39% vs base 18%, lift 2.13 [1.53,2.94], recall 31%, winners flagged 8.5% (8/81). >50%: 68 fired, precision 44%, lift 2.43 [1.65,3.47], winners 5.9% (6/81); per snapshot 2.47/2.44; mcap>=400 cr 2.97; liquidation/compulsory exit only 5.19 [2.78,8.70]; live stratum only 2.06 [0.40,3.97]. Rising pledge (>=10pp in a year) 2.93 [0.78,6.93] on 13 rows (exploratory). Caught: ABG Shipyard, Sical, Essar Shipping, KSK Energy, Gammon, Ballarpur, Coffee Day, Gayatri, B.L. Kashyap, IVRCL, Future Consumer, Sadbhav (>25%), RCom (>25%). Cost: Alok Industries 2016 (7.1x), Jindal Stainless 2018 (8.9x), Granules, Birlasoft, Dr Agarwal's, Steel Exchange; >25% also Aurionpro, Zen Technologies. Missed Jet Airways 2018 (pledges came later). 58-60% overlap with interest cover <1.5x (post-hoc).

title: PROPOSAL (not adopted): disqualifiers v3 - v2 structure kept; promoter pledge promoted to the top graded red flag with numeric levels (>25% red, >50% strong red, rising = escalate); cash-flow tells confirmed as questions; no mechanical any-flag gate
body: Builds on insight:disqualifiers-v2-proposal (unchanged) after the survivorship-free Indian back-test (insight:bt-hard-filters-india-v2-2026-summary). HARD AT ENTRY (unchanged from v2, judgment-only, untestable mechanically): H1a fake cash, H1b implausible economics after a written unit-economics check, H1c unverifiable profits, H4 pump patterns, H5 related-party leakage, H2 auditor exit over disagreement/qualified opinion, H3 rating not cooperating. HARD AT EXIT (unchanged): H2 and the strongest accounting-trouble events. GRADED RED (override template): promoter pledge >50% of promoter holding = strong (written override must state why, the lender, margin-call price vs current price) - tested lift 2.43 [1.65,3.47], 5.9% of winners; pledge >25% = red - lift 2.13 [1.53,2.94], 8.5% of winners; rising pledge >=10pp in a year = escalate (13 cases, untested); accounting-trouble events, dilution, solvency set as before (S1/S5 India = questions-leaning-red per L27). COMBINATION: pledge plus interest cover <1.5x = main 'look much harder, size small' prompt (post-hoc, needs forward check; the two overlap ~60%, so do not count them as independent votes). QUESTIONS, NOT FLAGS (confirmed on survivorship-free data): CFO/PAT 5y (<0.3 lift 2.08, CI 0.57-3.85, 11% of winners), debt growth with negative CFO (0.83), other-income share (1.36), debtor-day jumps (1.51; judge by counterparty). NO MECHANICAL ANY-FLAG GATE: ANY of the five flags 47% of later >=3x winners for lift 1.31. MOVED TO STAGE 5 (unchanged): P/E. Nothing mechanical is hard. WHAT WOULD CHANGE IT: pledge >50% lift >=4 on O_fail with CI >1 in a later snapshot set (2020, 2022) would make it hard; a forward record showing pledge overrides lose money would tighten the override.
